top_signals.title: US Core CPI Rises More Than Expected in August
top_signals.summary: A key gauge of US consumer prices climbed by more than expected last month, bolstering the case for Federal Reserve officials to raise interest rates next week. Michael McKee breaks down the data on Bloomberg Television. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: US Convertible Bond Market Hits Record as AI Spending Surges
top_signals.summary: US convertible bond sales have reached their highest annual total on record, according to data compiled by Bloomberg, as companies look to fund heavy artificial intelligence-related spending.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.summary: Ground beef prices edged higher in August, signaling little progress in the Trump administration’s offensive against the record costs with only two months left until midterm elections.

top_signals.title: Microsoft Excel KB5002914 update breaks copy and paste for some users
top_signals.summary: Microsoft Excel users report that this week's KB5002914 Office security update is breaking copy-and-paste operations and formula dragging, with affected users saying that removing or rolling back the update restores normal functionality. [...]

top_signals.title: IDScan confirms breach after hackers offer 153 million driver’s license scans for sale
top_signals.summary: A notice dated September 4 but not widely shared shows that IDScan acknowledged a data breach but did not specify how many people were affected.
